==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am playing with an old action figure from someone else's collection. The action figure malfunctions and starts dripping glowing purple ink. The ink starts to move around on its own and spread across my body.

The ink overtakes me. I am transformed into a celestial magical girl. My body looks like it is made up of glittering purple stars.

My UFO detector went off during the night. Maybe my dream was actually an astral body alien abduction? Maybe the ink was some kind of alien experiment?
